findings.description: Checkpoint verification and deserialization reopened a mutable path.
findings.correction: Hash, authenticate, and deserialize the same private snapshot, including explicit legacy migration.
findings.validation_performed: Six synthetic snapshot regressions passed; no production artifacts or unsafe payloads used.
findings.reopen_conditions: Any loader reopens a path after verifying a different stream.

findings.description: Concurrent first-use trust-key creation could overwrite another creator.
findings.correction: Publish a fully fsynced private candidate using an atomic no-clobber hard link, then return the persisted winner. Existing keys are never rotated. Unsupported filesystems fail closed.
findings.validation_performed: Eight synchronized threads and two independent processes agree on the persisted temporary key; existing/corrupt-key and no-clobber failure regressions passed.

findings.description: Device wait loops held a global lock needed by unrelated releases.
findings.correction: Hold the global mutex only for nonblocking acquisition and reference bookkeeping; wait and cancellation run outside it. Failed constructors own no reference and close is synchronized/idempotent.
findings.validation_performed: Unrelated-release, cancellation, timeout, failed-constructor ownership, and shared-reference regressions passed using synthetic devices and temporary OS locks.

findings.description: Diagnostic provenance failures replaced the original training exception.
findings.correction: Catch secondary provenance errors, attach a diagnostic note, preserve the original exception object, and deny resumability when provenance is unavailable. Existing successful-provenance accounting conditions are retained.
findings.validation_performed: Four fault-injection combinations cover RuntimeError/OSError with healthy/failing provenance. No real training is executed.

findings.description: Linux-target mypy rejected Windows msvcrt attributes and blocked CI.
findings.correction: Use sys.platform guards recognized by mypy. CI runs the unchanged 23-file typed safety boundary for both linux and win32; no type-ignore or gate suppression was added.
findings.validation_performed: Both complete 23-file type-check targets pass. CI-contract and dispatch regression tests also pass.

findings.description: Logical and physical GPU labels produced different device leases.
findings.correction: All production CUDA acquisitions use a runtime-UUID factory and one physical namespace. Missing UUIDs and mismatching UUID claims fail closed. Competing processes and containers must share the lease directory.
findings.validation_performed: 53 selected tests passed, including cross-process experiment/training exclusion with mocked CUDA discovery. Both 23-file type-check targets passed; no GPU workload was run.
